item.description:
## Changes
- Pressing Space on an action item's Edit button from the keyboard now puts the cursor in the editor, so you can type straight away. Before, focus moved on to Send to Reminders.

## Changes
- With keyboard navigation on, Tab no longer stops on an action item's hidden Edit and Send to Reminders buttons. They now appear while either has focus, so you can reach and press them from the keyboard.

## Changes
- Back-to-back calls get their own recordings. A recording Ahoy started for a detected call now stops 3 seconds after the call app lets go of the microphone (it was 10), so hanging up and joining the next call a few seconds later no longer runs both into one recording. - New Advanced settings, at the end of Settings: how long a call app must let go of the microphone before recording stops, how long it must hold it before recording starts, and the shortest recording kept (0 keeps all). Type any whole number of seconds or step by 1 with the arrows. - Scrolling Action items with the pointer over the window is smooth again; with many calls it could stall for up to a few seconds.
